name: BlueprintPrimer
title: Blueprint Primer - exact item requests
author: bits-orio
description: Prime a furnace, assembler or chest with the exact ingredients and fuel amounts its recipe needs, down to a partial stack. Chests also take exact item counts. Drag over a row, ghost or built, to prime every machine of one kind, or stamp primed blueprints. Boilers, burner drills and locomotives get just the fuel. Construction robots deliver the item request.
